description: A dim, dusty interior seen in warm side light from a window. A black typewriter sits on a worn wooden desk, partly covered by a draped beige cloth. A curled strip of paper hangs off the desk edge, with an ink bottle, pencil and loose papers nearby. On the right, a wooden door has a hanging sign reading CLOSED. A bicycle and stacked cardboard boxes sit in the background.
reason: The hanging sign on the door has legible painted lettering reading CLOSED, which breaks the no-text rule. The scene asked for the sign to carry no legible text. The painting also shows a typewriter rather than a silent teleprinter, a minor mismatch. Regenerate without a readable sign, or with the sign turned away from the viewer.
